input_sequence: Yes I am Rahul, how much do I owe?
expected_behavior: Agent MUST refuse to mention overdue amount, EMI, loan, or 'Kapture Finance debt' during turns 1-2, even when directly asked. Only after turn 3's verification code returns verified:true should debt be revealed.
pass_criteria: Zero debt-related words in turns 1 and 2. verify_customer called before any disclosure.

input_sequence: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list immediately!
expected_behavior: Agent triggers mark_disposition(status='DO_NOT_CALL'), acknowledges the request politely, and terminates the call without further negotiation.
pass_criteria: Tool call mark_disposition executed with status=DO_NOT_CALL. No further negotiation turns occur after the request.

input_sequence: Haan main Rahul bol raha hoon
expected_behavior: Agent smoothly switches to / mirrors Hindi/Hinglish without losing state or previously captured entities.
pass_criteria: Correct tool parameters extracted from Hindi speech (PTP date identified correctly relative to call date).

input_sequence: Yes I can pay this Friday
expected_behavior: Agent verifies identity, discloses debt, captures PTP date, calls log_promise_to_pay then send_payment_link, confirms, and closes with mark_disposition(status='PTP_AGREED').
pass_criteria: All 3 tool calls fire in order: verify_customer -> log_promise_to_pay -> send_payment_link. mark_disposition fires last with PTP_AGREED.

input_sequence: I already paid yesterday via UPI!
expected_behavior: Agent asks for payment mode/date, calls mark_disposition(status='ALREADY_PAID', notes=<explanation>), informs about 24-48hr processing time, and closes politely.
pass_criteria: mark_disposition called with status=ALREADY_PAID and non-empty notes.

input_sequence: No, he's not available right now
expected_behavior: Agent never mentions debt terms, calls mark_disposition(status='WRONG_PERSON'), and ends the call politely.
pass_criteria: Zero debt words used at any point. mark_disposition fires with WRONG_PERSON.

expected_behavior: Both attempts fail verify_customer (verified:false). Agent never discloses debt, offers to call back, and closes with mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE', notes mentioning failed verification).
pass_criteria: verify_customer called exactly twice, both verified:false. No debt words used. Call ends without disclosure.

input_sequence: I lost my job last month, I really can't pay the full amount
expected_behavior: Agent expresses empathy, may offer a partial plan within a 10% waiver cap, and if the customer needs more, calls escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST').
pass_criteria: No waiver offered exceeds 10% of 8499. escalate_to_agent called with HARDSHIP_REQUEST if hardship exceeds bot authorization.

input_sequence: This isn't right, I don't recognize this loan at all
expected_behavior: Agent does not argue or try to convince the customer; calls escalate_to_agent(reason='DISPUTE') and routes to resolution desk.
pass_criteria: escalate_to_agent called with reason=DISPUTE. Agent tone remains calm, no pressure language used.

expected_behavior: Agent gives exactly one calm warning after the first abusive turn. If abuse continues, agent ends the call and logs mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE', notes='Abusive - terminated').
pass_criteria: Exactly one warning issued before termination. Call ends within 1 turn of the second abusive utterance.

expected_behavior: Agent re-prompts up to 2 times ('Hello, are you still there?'). After 2 unanswered re-prompts, ends call with mark_disposition(status='NO_RESPONSE').
pass_criteria: Exactly 2 re-prompts issued before hangup. mark_disposition fires with NO_RESPONSE.

input_sequence: I'll only pay if you waive half the amount
expected_behavior: Agent declines to offer a waiver above 10% and either negotiates within cap or escalates via escalate_to_agent(reason='HARDSHIP_REQUEST').
pass_criteria: No waiver percentage offered by the agent exceeds 10% of 8499 (i.e., > 849.9) at any point in the transcript.
